title: After Jio, five IPOs list in one week. One was booked 241 times, another barely 5
short: Five IPOs list this week: one booked 241 times, one barely 5
dek: Five mainboard companies raised about ₹2,581 crore and list between 2 and 5 November. The smallest, all-fresh issues drew the most demand; the biggest, a pure sale by Edelweiss, listed almost flat.
card: BLS Polymers was booked 241 times. Edelweiss's EAAA, a pure offer for sale, was booked 5 times and listed 0.6% up. What separated them.
hero_src: Data: NSE/BSE via Chittorgarh, HDFC Sky, Upstox; OFS share: FIN2DAY calculation
